reports.subject: Matheus Jesus

reports.said: Looked tired against Urawa. This is the first game after that run. He starts at No. 10.

reports.subject: Kenshin Yasuda
reports.said: On the bench. The J.League scoring table lists No. 7 with 4 goals, tied with Jesus.

reports.subject: Koki Ogawa
reports.source: Gekisaka, Sept. 20; J.League preview, Satoshi Gunji; Machida club page
reports.said: Second on the club with 4 goals. Quoted as a striker who has to show it with goals after a national-team snub. Used as a second-half substitute in Shanghai. The team sheet is not out.

reports.subject: Machida clean sheets
reports.said: Seven straight official clean sheets in October. Genta Tani is the reason. Two days after Shanghai.

reports.subject: Takashi Usami
reports.said: Three straight goals, including a free kick. He has beaten Tani from a free kick before. Jun Ichimori is suspended. Masaaki Higashiguchi, 33 minutes this season, is next.
